$comment: WO-6 casting tables — machine-readable transcription of final-plan.md Part 2 (per-role castings), Part 3.4 (review mandate + R0 matrix), Part 5.5 (pool states / degradation ladder), and the Q0 automatic triggers (seat 19). WO-14b leg 2b (readiness-repair tranche, 2026-09-01 owner rulings): twelve roles retired — merged into Builder/Investigator, or (A1) a documented workflow — via the mergedClasses table below; classes remain routing labels in registry/classes.json regardless. Builder gained a four-tier ladder (bounded/standard/dense/deep) absorbing Principal's Opus rung. Architect and Sweeper carry owner-settable seat toggles (defaultEnabled). The registry (registry/classes.json) owns the taxonomy; this file owns who runs it at which rung under which pool state. Edit the plan first, then mirror here — router/router.js cross-checks this file against the registry at load and fails closed on any drift. Two entries are WO-6 defaults the plan leaves unstated, marked unstatedInPlan.
source: plans/cross-compare/agent-role-architecture/final-plan.md — Parts 2, 3.4, 5.5; WO-6 order; WO-14b leg 2b owner rulings (roster-review-refutations-2026-09-01.md, readiness-repair-tranche-2026-09-01.md)

effortLadders.$comment: Effort ladders differ per vendor (§2.0); 'off' is Haiku thinking-off; specials are dispatch-time values the Conductor seat carries.

poolStateLadder.$comment: §5.5, evaluated per bucket by the Quartermaster; the Conductor announces every rung change. No rung edits the mandatory set. 'Exhausted' is the exhaustion-matrix state past Red (allowance gone or hard-throttled out).

behavior.Amber: Authoring on this bucket re-casts to the healthy pool's mirrors, per role; review unchanged (last thing to sacrifice). P15 gate arms: below 40% AU-opus, no Opus dispatch without Quartermaster confirmation
behavior.Orange: Authoring on this bucket suspended; ceiling seats deferred (AU-fable stops first); only review, verification and in-flight completion draw
behavior.Red: Only calls that close already-authored changes. Mandatory classes whose cross-family direction needs this bucket do not close (wait / named human / park). Preferred classes may take the disclosed degraded path. Irreversible work waits, unconditionally
behavior.Exhausted: Per the exhaustion matrix: T0 work and cross-family-reviewable closure continue on the healthy pool; consequential closure needing this family waits or goes to a named human

reserve.$comment: P0's dynamic review reserve (seat 24) with WO-2's measured numbers. required = (forecast mandatory-review draw + forecast incident draw) × (1 + uncertaintyBuffer), floored at max(floorFractionOfBucket, cost of two gate-class reviews).
reserve.twoGateClassReviewsCostSource: WO-2 throughput probe 2026-08-28: 20 gate-class reviews drew ~3 percentage points of the weekly Codex window (~8%→11%)

liveness.$comment: §3.4 deployment gate (P10), settled by WO-2 — the mandate is active on the pinned cross-vendor review lane.

mandatoryReview.$comment: §3.4 — the set that can never degrade; fixed at design time, no degradation rung edits it. Unchanged by WO-14b leg 2b: A1's row is unreachable now that A1 has no role (dispatch returns typed RETIRED_WORKFLOW before review is ever computed) and stays as documentation.
unavailableOptions: named human expert review recorded in the ledger
park unmerged with HOLD: cross-family review unavailable

reviewMatrix.$comment: R0's computed casting (seat 21): family(reviewer) ∉ families(author + co-authors), evaluated at dispatch from the recorded family set. The Terra T1 lane is qualification-gated on WO-12f (not yet run) — Sol · high until the flag flips, and any pass is provisional with live monitoring.

degradedSameFamilyCandidates.$comment: Preferred-band degraded path only (§3.4): fresh-context, different-model, same-family review + mandatory Verifier, review.cross_family = false disclosed.

q0Triggers.$comment: Seat 19's automatic triggers — policy, not discretion. The scheduler creates Q0 when the implementation order is created; a missing required Q0 order blocks the work. Q0 is always Director-created, never implementer-spawned. Class ids are unchanged by WO-14b leg 2b's role retirements — E0/E1/E3/E5/E6/E8 still trigger exactly as before even though they now dispatch through Builder via mergedClasses.

primary.note: the interactive session model IS the Conductor; no bootstrap layer

mirror.note: activated from a signed control checkpoint
restrictions: may not semantically close OpenAI-authored T2/T3 artifacts
may not author-and-approve the same plan
may not override an Anthropic verdict

Conductor.neverReason: owner ruling 2026-08-28: Opus holds no USER-DIALOGUE seat; never any cheap tier (judgment seat, P4)

nebulous.note: especially complex, nebulous, or ambiguous goals; owner judgment at intake; Max-or-above Anthropic seat

exhaustionFallback.note: when the Codex allowance is exhausted

mirror.note: the opposite family of whichever primary is cast; under the Sol default this is the Anthropic lane

Architect.securityRouteFilter: security-sensitive planning is a hard route-filter to the Sol lane — never the Fable casting (silent classifier fallback on cyber/bio topics)

mirror.note: preferred when the defect is environment- or tool-loop-shaped; wrong for race hunts — the concurrency blind spot

ceiling.note: trail cold and blocking, or after two failed hunts with different hypotheses

preferredBounded.note: bounded, short-horizon, fully-specified, deterministically-verifiable orders only; Luna never receives under-specified work

primary.note: orders expected to run longer or whose spec is thinner than Luna's bar

denseMirror.note: WO-14b Builder ladder: the dense tier's cross-vendor lawful substitute, walked under the bucket ladder like any other mirror

denseOverrideSol.note: WO-14b Builder ladder: dense tier, override-only — reachable solely through castOpts.override from the Conductor, subject to the Quartermaster's review-reserve check (leg 4); never walked

deepPrimary.note: WO-14b Builder ladder: deep tier preferred — absorbs Principal's (E3) retired primary rung

deepOverrideSol.note: WO-14b Builder ladder: deep tier, override-only — a deliberate Conductor choice, never a degradation target; subject to the Quartermaster's review-reserve check (leg 4); never walked

tiers.$comment: WO-14b Builder ladder (owner-ruled 2026-09-01, adopted as proposed): a tier on the order picks a preferred casting plus an ordered cross-vendor substitute list walked under the bucket ladder; override-only entries are reachable solely through castOpts.override, never walked.

Builder.guardrail: Luna never receives under-specified work — the guardrail survives the promotion

reversibleT1.note: only reversible T1 extraction/transformation/query sub-work AFTER the integrity design is fixed by the primary or A0

noMirrorFor.irreversible: declared no-mirror exception: the irreversible half. Pool pressure changes WHEN T2/T3 data work is scheduled, never WHO prepares it; if the Anthropic pool is exhausted, irreversible data work waits

mirror.note: strong at find-and-harden, weaker on exploitation reasoning

Red Team.neverReason: a policy fact, not a capability judgment: silent classifier fallback on cyber topics — a security review routed there may be answered by a different model with nothing saying so. Hard route-filter

Test Designer.castRule: cast opposite the implementation author's family; a human-authored implementation takes whichever pool is healthier, tie → the Anthropic lane (protects the OpenAI review reserve, Part 5)
Test Designer.directorCreated: Q0 is always Director-created, never spawned by the implementer — the independence is the point

crossFamilyByConstruction.reason: mirror substitution is unlawful by construction — the seat is cast opposite the implementation author's family, so substituting the other lane under pool outage would place the test designer same-family with the author, violating the invariant. router.js has no special-cased Q0 outage handling: rung selection always names vsAnthropicAuthor or vsOpenaiAuthor from implementationAuthorFamily, and this role carries no `mirror` rung, so when that rung's bucket cannot take the authoring purpose, cast()'s generic degradation fallback finds role.rungs.mirror undefined, the Data-Engineer-only reversibleT1 fallback does not apply, and it falls through to the final refusal: outcome WAIT, reason 'no lawful casting: <model> bucket at <state> ... and the role declares no mirror for this work'. Outage means wait, or a typed UNAVAILABLE at the caller — never a same-family substitution.

Reviewer.computedRule: family(reviewer) ∉ families(author + co-authors), evaluated at dispatch from the ledger's recorded family set — the full co-author set, never just the original author. Use reviewer(), never cast()

Sweeper.castRule: never the instance that performed the fan-out; prefer the opposite family from the author
Sweeper.benchedNote: owner ruling 2026-09-01: BENCHED, not ditched — file stays, seat disabled behind the seat-toggle mechanism (defaultEnabled: false). Re-enable trigger: a missed-site escape surfacing after a wide change in the first live tests. Disabled dispatch of S0 carries fallback:'verifier-census' (the Conductor's chain-final step falls to the Verifier's deterministic census re-run, disclosed on the order).

modelAssist.note: checklist classification against explicit yes/no criteria only, cheapest tier with pool room, ensemble votes where a wrong vote must be absorbed; every result records model-assist provenance
deterministic code over the ledger; cheapest-tier model only for summarization

mergedClasses.$comment: WO-14b leg 2b (owner rulings 2026-09-01): every class stays a routing label in registry/classes.json even though its dedicated role/file is retired. A1 has no role at all — dispatch returns typed RETIRED_WORKFLOW naming the documented workflow. N0/N1/N2/M0 merge into Investigator (mode = the former class id; N0 keeps the read-only pin behavior). E0/E1/E3/E5/E6/E8/D0 merge into Builder at a default tier (mode = the former class id, overridable by an explicit order.tier); E8 additionally widens Builder's context shapes to include repo/haystack (the census-first work the old Refactorer needed). WO-14b leg 2 fix round (2026-09-01, findings 6/7): an entry may also carry `unavailable` (medium -> reason; M0 restores the retired Archivist's raw video/audio UNAVAILABLE boundary, checked against castOpts.medium) and `contextShapesOnly` (an exact replacement set, not additive — E1 restores the retired Runner's packet-only ceiling).

A1.workflow: A1 comparative-plan synthesis under Conductor + both Reviewer lanes + owner

unavailable.videoAudio: declared no-mirror exception: raw video and audio go below the model layer — deterministic frame extraction + local speech-to-text, else typed UNAVAILABLE; never a silent narrowing to stills

E1.note: WO-14b leg 2 fix round (finding 7): the retired Runner's packet-only ceiling — the hardest constraint in the roster — survives the merge as an exact override, not an additive widening.

E3.note: Conductor rider 2026-09-01: deep work inherits Principal's repo shape — the merge absorbs the rung, not the shape restriction
